Definition: Joshijah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Josiah is named 48 times in the Bible, and the passages here are 1 Kings 13:2; 2 Kings 21:24; 1 Chronicles 3:14. In 1 Kings 13:2 we read, "And he cried against the altar in the word of the LORD, and said, O altar, altar, thus saith the LORD; Behold..." The same name belongs to more than one man, and 1 Chronicles 3:14 names another of them.
TheologicalSignificance: Josiah is part of the family history Scripture preserves, and I believe those lists are not filler. God kept the name, and that tells me he kept the person.
